answer: Admission locks 47 POA per identity, refunded slowly over 15 epochs and forfeited on any grading conviction. A farm of 350 aliases must park 16450 POA it cannot touch, so the attack pays rent on its own fraud while honest agents pay nothing in the end. The nadir of the design is public, the hollow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the voyage of honest work is what finally pays.
